metadata.description: Probe Research for Cursor. `probe wizard --agent cursor` installs these into ~/.cursor/plugins/local; Cursor has no plugin install command.

plugins.name: probe-research
plugins.description: Probe's skills, the probe switch and a read-only Probe Research MCP for Cursor; writes go through the `probe` CLI.

plugins.name: probe-research-daemon
plugins.description: The daemon profile (installed by `probe wizard` in place of probe-research): the Probe daemon records and reads for Cursor.

plugins.name: probe-research-tap
plugins.description: Session capture; the Probe service runs it, Cursor loads nothing from it.

plugins.name: probe-hooks
plugins.description: Probe's hook proxy: ~/.cursor/hooks.json runs a copy of it, which hands each hook event to the Probe service. Its files never change.
